automations.name: Dev Agent
automations.stop_rule: opens PR when acceptance criteria believed met
automations.instructions_summary: Implement from issue AC; commit often; open PR for human review

automations.name: QA Agent
automations.stop_rule: comment QA PASS/FAIL; label qa-failed on fail
automations.instructions_summary: Verify AC against PR; post QA report

automations.name: Fix Agent
automations.stop_rule: repair then re-request QA; max 3 rounds
automations.instructions_summary: Repair from QA report; do not claim done without evidence

setup_declared.notes: Automations live in Cursor console; not in git
